title: Name the result sender and resume owner for every wait in the existing coordination skill
outcome: Every wait has an explicit owner and direct result handoff, without watcher processes
acceptance: The existing coder-test-execution skill (.agents/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md, in Engram and TermAl) carries the agreed one-paragraph rule verbatim: “Every wait names one session to wake, the exact result, and what delivers it directly to the waiter: the host's own completion (a test-run wait or a delegation wait) or a named session; no polling. Never wait for a conditional resource state: LAUNCH NOW (start at once), or its current holder sends END (its message that the resource is free) directly to the named next waiter. A foreground run the turn itself waits on is not a wait on another session. No watcher; a coordinator assigns any unnamed wait immediately.”
The rule adds no new skill, approval, gate, tracker step or monitoring process; the portable skill docs/skills/engram-use/SKILL.md points to it in one line.
Both coordinators receive the wording and apply the same rule; current active waits are checked for a named resume owner/result sender and any unclear handoff is corrected directly.

completion.summary: Landed the jointly agreed named wait handoff in the existing coder test execution skill, linked from the portable guide. The source matches the landed commit. The cross-project wording match, operational adoption and fresh independent acceptance are recorded.
